items.why: Fear is easing as the rout pauses and dip buyers offer support after the worst selloff in 19 months.
Chip stocks are stabilizing after the steep AI selloff, with Nasdaq futures rising as AI stocks recover.
AI stocks are seeing some buying after the worst rout in 19 months, with tech edging up after AI slowdown fears hit values.
Dip buyers are offering support as the stock rout pauses, lifting the broader tape.

market_note: Nasdaq futures up 1.69% and S&P futures up 0.76%, while Dow futures slip 0.19% and the VIX falls 11.57%.
summary: Stocks are rebounding after the worst rout in 19 months, with the Nasdaq recovering as AI stocks see some buying. The jobs report came in stronger than expected, with 165,000 jobs added in October, though that may pressure the Fed.
